description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Zenith Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode: Quistis], [Soul Break Gauge +250], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user. Grants [Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] to user based on if entry damage was Water/Poison.

description.name: Zenith Mode: Quistis
description.text: Increases Water and Poison infusion damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Water and Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Water 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Poison 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3
